text:
mia: Heads-up — noticed ~18% p50 latency increase on GQA runs for mistral-7b after kernel v3.2 landed. perfbot alerted :eyes:

perfbot: anomaly detected in /v1/generate (dedicated pool). p50 +18%, throughput -12%. triggered by kernel3.2 rollout.

oliver: Can repro locally. Microprofile shows attention kernel switching to a generic path for some head layouts.

mia: Repro on dedicated, running a fine-grained profile now. I see extra memcpy cycles when num_key_value_heads != num_heads.

kevin: Are these tests GQA (num_key_value_heads=32) or MQA (8)? That changes how the KV cache is packed.

mia: GQA with 32 heads. We did earlier MQA experiments and fragmentation looked different. Paged layout shows many small fragments for mixed seq lengths.

sarah: Can you drop the model config snippet? curious about rope scaling and kernel hints.

mia: snippet pasted below:
```
model_config:
  model: mistral-7b
  kv_layout: paged_compact
  num_key_value_heads: 32
  kv_dim: 128
  rope_scale: 1.125
  kernel_pref: auto
  batch_hint: latency
```

chao: rope_scale > 1 can change memory stride and invalidate some kernel fast paths. auto kernel_pref may pick the generic implementation that does extra copies.

oliver: microbench numbers (seq=512, bs=8):
```
attention_generic: 12.3ms
attention_fast: 8.2ms
```
kernel auto selected generic for long requests (>1k) because stride heuristics mis-estimated.

mia: Quick experiment: lowering num_key_value_heads from 32->16 improved throughput ~9% but memory usage rose. obvious tradeoff.

sarah: fragmentation observation: paged_compact creates many small allocations when requests vary in length, hurting coalescing. slab layout or coalescer window may help.

kevin: Proposed test config to try:
```
kv_layout: slab_16
num_key_value_heads: 24
rope_scale: 1.0
kernel_pref: hint:attention_fast
batch_hint: throughput
```

mia: kicking that off against the dedicated cluster now, will update.

perfbot: deploy v3.2.1 rolled to dedicated pool at 2141601000, monitoring route /v1/generate

mia: initial results: slab_16 +24 heads +fast kernel hint -> p50 down ~7%, throughput +10%. tail still elevated for very long sequences (>2k).

chao: sounds like a kernel heuristic bug around stride handling when rope_scale != 1 and when kv heads not equal logical heads. I'll open a kernel-heuristics PR to avoid memcpy fallback and add a path that supports non-unit rope scaling.

oliver: also adding a regression harness that simulates mixed MQA/GQA traffic with paged fragmentation patterns so we don't regress on allocation layout again.

mia: thanks. I'll pin the updated slab_16 config for affected tenants and draft a short runbook with mitigation steps (pin config, rollback kernel, patch timeline).

sarah: :thumbsup:

chao: Action items: 1) chao to PR kernel heuristics 2) oliver to add regression harness 3) mia to rollout pinned configs and runbook 4) kevin to run memory/latency tradeoff matrix for heads 8/16/24/32

mia: copied. I'll post a short summary in eng-runtime updates once we have kernel PR and regression test. Cheers. :rocket:
